findings.description: The Lambda environment variables contain an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform configuration. These values can be exposed through source control, Terraform state, or Lambda environment-variable access, enabling unauthorized use of the associated AWS identity.
The function uses the end-of-life nodejs12.x runtime. An unsupported runtime no longer receives security updates, increasing exposure to known runtime vulnerabilities.
